title: Elihu Speaks: God Cannot Be Wicked

questions.question: Hear my words, you wise men, and give ear to me, you who what?
questions.explanation: Job 34:2 (ESV): "Hear my words, you wise men, and give ear to me, you who know;"

questions.question: For the ear tests words as the palate tastes what?
questions.explanation: Job 34:3 (ESV): "for the ear tests words as the palate tastes food."

questions.question: Let us choose what is right; let us know among ourselves what is what?
questions.explanation: Job 34:4 (ESV): "Let us choose what is right; let us know among ourselves what is good."

questions.question: For Job has said, 'I am in the right, and God has taken away my what?'
questions.explanation: Job 34:5 (ESV): "For Job has said, 'I am in the right, and God has taken away my right;'"

questions.question: What man is like Job, who drinks up scoffing like what?
questions.explanation: Job 34:7 (ESV): "What man is like Job, who drinks up scoffing like water,"

questions.question: Far be it from God that he should do wickedness, and from the Almighty that he should do what?
questions.explanation: Job 34:10 (ESV): "far be it from God that he should do wickedness, and from the Almighty that he should do wrong."

questions.question: If he should set his heart to it and gather to himself his spirit and his what?
questions.explanation: Job 34:14 (ESV): "If he should set his heart to it and gather to himself his spirit and his breath,"

questions.question: All flesh would perish together, and man would return to what?
questions.explanation: Job 34:15 (ESV): "all flesh would perish together, and man would return to dust."

questions.question: God shows no partiality to princes, nor regards the rich more than whom?
questions.explanation: Job 34:19 (ESV): "who shows no partiality to princes and does not regard the rich more than the poor, for they are all the work of his hands?"

questions.question: For his eyes are on the ways of a man, and he sees all his what?
questions.explanation: Job 34:21 (ESV): "For his eyes are on the ways of a man, and he sees all his steps."

questions.question: There is no gloom or deep darkness where what kind of workers may hide themselves?
questions.explanation: Job 34:22 (ESV): "There is no gloom or deep darkness where evildoers may hide themselves."

questions.question: He shatters the mighty without investigation and sets whom in their place?
questions.explanation: Job 34:24 (ESV): "He shatters the mighty without investigation and sets others in their place."

questions.question: When he strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of whom?
questions.explanation: Job 34:26 (ESV): "He strikes them for their wickedness in a place for all to see," (Note: ESV says "in the open sight of others").

questions.question: Job speaks without knowledge; his words are without what?
questions.explanation: Job 34:35 (ESV): "Job speaks without knowledge; his words are without insight."

questions.question: For he adds rebellion to his sin; he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against whom?
questions.explanation: Job 34:37 (ESV): "For he adds rebellion to his sin; he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God."

key_verse_text: Therefore, hear me, you men of understanding: far be it from God that he should do wickedness, and from the Almighty that he should do wrong.
